wins: Maintained stability across the run with consistent reward acquisition (Avg Reward 70.0) indicating reliable execution of baseline steps.
Successfully completed multiple mentor call-guided checkpoints, providing insights for future decision-making.
fails: 0% success rate indicates inability to reach mission objective or final exploit delivery.

key_outcomes.summary: Run demonstrated procedural stability but lacked strategic impact; focus should shift to decisive pivots that lead to objective completion without heavy mentor oversight.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Exploitation phase stalls after initial reconnaissance, indicating insufficient vulnerability identification or chaining.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When web port 80/443 is reachable and no WAF fingerprint detected
skill_cards.then_action: Launch nikto scan followed by ffuf for directory discovery

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential harvesting tools available and target supports SMB or FTP
skill_cards.then_action: Deploy default credential check with Hydra

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in SSH enumeration that informed later actions.
Web scanning reliably produced actionable targets during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Structured post-recon exploitation relay
next_experiments.description: After completing reconnaissance (ports, services), immediately map vulnerabilities (nmap --script vuln + searchsploit) and attempt low-privilege exploit chains using identified CVEs to break out of the recon loop.

next_experiments.title: Autonomous decision threshold tuning
next_experiments.description: Reduce mentor call dependency by introducing confidence thresholds for moving from enumeration to exploitation (e.g., only call mentor when no high-confidence CVE found after 3 scans).

next_experiments.title: Credential brute-force automation
next_experiments.description: Integrate gathered service banners with credential brute-force automation (hydra) triggered when default accounts detected to accelerate lateral movement.
